newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: YACHTING-AUSTRALIA TO ENTER 1997 ADMIRAL'S CUP.
newsitem.headline: YACHTING-AUSTRALIA TO ENTER 1997 ADMIRAL'S CUP.

text.p: Australia will challenge for 1997 Admiral's Cup yachting regatta at Cowes after missing the last Cup two years ago because of the unavailability of top-class sailors and the high costs involved, officials said on Tuesday.
Veteran skipper Syd Fischer will lead a team of three boats for the eight-race regatta in July and August, culminating in the Fastnet Race, off the English coast.
A veteran of seven Admiral's Cup regattas and numerous America's Cup campaigns, Fischer will be joined by skippers Steve Kulmar and John Calvert-Jones.

"It will be a strong team, using the best available yachts and skippered and crewed by Australia's best and most experienced yachtsmen," Australian Yachting Federation's Offshore Committee chairman David Kellett said on Tuesday.
Kellet said Australia has twice won the Admiral's Cup and came within 0.25 of a point of victory in 1993.

The unavailability of many top yachtsmen, including Fischer, because of America's Cup duties in 1995 and the high cost of shipping boats were factors in Australia's decision not to send a team to Cowes two years ago, yachting officials said.
